sections.heading: Introduction
sections.body: Etxauri is a limestone climbing area near Pamplona and one of Navarra’s important crags.

sections.heading: History and context
warnings: No sourced history and context content found for this pass.

sections.heading: Rock and climbing character
sections.body: Legacy notes and PlanetMountain both support limestone climbing with technical walls, slabs, crimps and overhanging faces.

sections.heading: Who it suits
sections.body: The 4a to 9a range supports a broad sport-climbing audience, but the legacy packet emphasizes technical climbing skill.

sections.heading: Grades and difficulty
sections.body: PlanetMountain reports more than 800 routes from 4a to 9a.

sections.heading: Season and conditions
sections.body: The legacy packet recommends autumn and spring and warns against summertime heat.
